description: This Java class defines a custom LinearLayout named CheckableLinearLayout which implements the Checkable interface. It adds a 'checked' state to the layout, allowing it to be used in list items with selectable or checkable features, particularly within AbsListView or similar components.

classes.name: CheckableLinearLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that implements the Checkable interface to support checkable list items with visual state changes.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Returns the current checked state of the layout.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state and updates the drawable state if the state changes.

methods.name: onCreateDrawableState
methods.description: Overrides the method to add the checked state to the drawable state array when checked.
